summary: Iteration 11 — Live UI smoke test of all 3 F2F48 Studio dry-run render pipelines + new admin-only 'Re-run as dry-run' button on active-card and every history row. AVATAR + FACELESS end-to-end walked through the live Studio UI (chip→modal→pick→script→generate→progress bar→video→history). COMPOSITE walked via curl against /api/studio/render (composite is not exposed in chip UI; backend confirms it lands in history). Re-run from active card and from history row both verified live — both fire a new dry_run:true render that walks stages 5%→25/20%→100% and produces a new history entry. All renders complete with BigBuckBunny.mp4 result_url and actual_cost_cents=0. Admin-only gating verified by code review (Studio.jsx lines 684 + 720 wrap both re-run buttons in {isAdmin && ...}). Backend gate (server.py:711) only restricts dry_run:FALSE override to admins — dry_run:TRUE coming from any logged-in user falls through to the env default (DRY_RUN_RENDERS=true), which is exactly the intended behaviour per spec.

verified_features.auth_admin_login: PASS — POST /api/auth/check with drcharitycampbell@gmail.com returns JWT; GET /api/auth/me returns isAdmin:true, dryRunDefault:true, entitlements=[base,shorts,studio].
verified_features.avatar_dry_run_live_ui: PASS — chip-avatar → avatar-card pick → chip-voice → voice-row pick → script fill → generate-btn. render-card appears, progress 5% (Queued) → 25% (Synthesizing voice on HeyGen) → 100% (Done) in ~2.5s. render-video visible with src=https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4. History row added.
verified_features.faceless_dry_run_live_ui: PASS — mode-faceless → chip-tts-voice → voice-row pick → bulk-prompts ('sunset over the ocean\ncity at night') → script fill → scene-source-0-ai + scene-source-1-ai → generate-btn. Progress 5% (Queued) → 20% (Kokoro voiceover) → 100% (Done) in ~2.8s. render-video with BigBuckBunny.mp4. History entry mode=faceless with scenes_n=2.
verified_features.composite_dry_run_api: PASS — POST /api/studio/render {mode:composite, script:'Composite test...', aspect:'9_16', avatar_id:TEST, voice_id:TEST} → completes in ~3-4s with status=complete, progress=100, result_url=BigBuckBunny.mp4, actual_cost_cents=0, dry_run=true. Verified GET /api/studio/history lists the composite job at the top.
verified_features.rerun_active_card_button: PASS — [data-testid='render-card-rerun-dryrun'] (RotateCw + 'Re-run as dry-run' label) appears on completed render-card. Click fires NEW dry_run:true render with same payload; progress bar restarts and walks to 100% in ~1.5s. New history entry confirmed (count went 8 → 10 after both re-run flows ran).
verified_features.rerun_history_row_button: PASS — [data-testid^='history-rerun-dryrun-'] icon button (RotateCw) present on every complete/failed history row (8 rows = 8 buttons). Click triggers GET /studio/render/{id} → POST /studio/render with dry_run:true. New render-card appears at top, walks stages to 100%.
verified_features.admin_only_gating_ui_code_review: PASS (code review) — Studio.jsx:684 wraps active-card re-run button in {isAdmin && (render.status === 'complete' || render.status === 'failed') && (...)}. Studio.jsx:720 wraps history-row re-run button in {isAdmin && ...}. Non-admin users will never see either button. rerenderAsDryRun handler (lines 263-292) only uses the apiClient (JWT auth header) — no admin-only state dep.
verified_features.admin_only_gating_backend_code_review: PASS (code review) — server.py:711 `if is_admin and payload.dry_run is not None: effective_dry_run = payload.dry_run else: effective_dry_run = DRY_RUN_RENDERS`. Dry_run:true from any user falls through to env default (true), so the dry-run path is open to all logged-in users. The admin gate is correctly only on dry_run:FALSE overrides — exactly per spec.
verified_features.cost_cap_path_unchanged: PASS (code review) — /studio/render runs the same estimate_render_cost_cents guard on every call regardless of dry_run flag. A re-run of a payload that exceeds the $1.50 cap would be rejected with 400 the same way the original was. Not exercised live (no oversized payload in history) but the code path is identical.
verified_features.sample_mp4_url: PASS — All 3 modes return result_url=https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4 from SAMPLE_VIDEO_URL. Video element renders and is playable in the UI.

ui_flows_not_completed_live_with_rationa.composite_via_ui: Composite mode is intentionally not exposed in the mode-toggle (only Avatar and Faceless chips). Per the request, this was verified via curl against /api/studio/render — it completes and lands in /api/studio/history, which is what the spec asked for.
ui_flows_not_completed_live_with_rationa.non_admin_negative_test: Could not log in as a non-admin user (Netlify auth wall + DEV_BYPASS_EMAIL is only the admin email). Gating was verified via code review of Studio.jsx:684 and 720 (both buttons inside {isAdmin && ...}) per the spec's explicit instruction.
ui_flows_not_completed_live_with_rationa.real_render_toggle: Did NOT flip [data-testid='admin-real-toggle'] on / fire a real render — by design, since DRY_RUN_RENDERS=true and the user is about to start their own real-render testing. This iteration was specifically a dry-run smoke pass.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still ~1185 lines — past the 700-line guideline (carried over from iter 10). The render pipelines (_run_render_avatar/_faceless/_composite) and cost-estimate math should be split into /app/backend/renders/*.py.

estimate_render_cost_cents TTS coefficient (server.py ~line 448, 0.5 cents per 1000 chars) is ~10x too low vs actual Kokoro/fal.ai pricing per iter-10 review. Recalibrate BEFORE flipping DRY_RUN_RENDERS=false, otherwise a real render could slip past the $1.50 cap.

_run_render_composite real-path (server.py:662-668) is still a TODO — finalizes failed when dry_run=false. The UI doesn't show a graceful error for this — would just show 'failed'. Either show a friendly toast or hide the real-toggle for composite mode (composite isn't user-facing in UI anyway, but admin curl could hit it).
AdminRenderControl.jsx still uses JSON.stringify(payload) as useEffect dep (per iter 10) — minor perf concern on large faceless payloads.

The active-card re-run button immediately replaces the current render state — there's no momentary visual 'restart' indicator (progress jumped from 100% to 25% directly in our test). Consider resetting progress to 0 first or showing a brief 'Re-firing…' label so admin can see the button click registered.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 dry-run modes complete: avatar+faceless live UI, composite curl)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all live-tested UI surfaces: avatar dry-run, faceless dry-run, active-card re-run button, history-row re-run button, admin panel visibility, default toggle state

test_credentials: drcharitycampbell@gmail.com (DEV_BYPASS, isAdmin=true, all entitlements). JWT stored as f48_studio_token in localStorage.
seed_data_creation: 5 dry-run renders created during this iteration: 1 composite (via curl), 1 avatar (live UI generate), 1 avatar (active-card re-run), 1 avatar (history-row re-run, completed twice in flight), 1 faceless (live UI generate). All dry_run=true with actual_cost_cents=0 so zero API spend. All visible in /api/studio/history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: User is now ready to flip DRY_RUN_RENDERS=false and start REAL-render testing on their side. All UI plumbing is verified: 3 pipelines walk stages correctly, sample MP4 renders + plays, history lists every job, and the new admin-only Re-run as dry-run button works on both the active card and every history row. The 2 carried-over code-review items from iter 10 (server.py size, TTS estimate coefficient) are STILL OPEN and should be tackled before flipping the real-render env var. New code-review item this iteration: the active-card re-run button doesn't visually reset progress to 0 before re-firing — minor UX nit. NO bugs blocking real-render rollout.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All implementation matches the spec.
